hook_line: New York Bans Horse-Drawn Carriages Under Romanch's Law
news_summary: The New York City Council voted 40 to 7 to phase out horse-drawn carriages by June 1, 2028, naming the law for Romanch Mahajan, 18, of Pathankot, who died in June when a carriage horse bolted in Central Park.

hook_stat.sub: City Council vote to end horse-drawn carriages in New York

diaspora_bullets: Romanch Mahajan, 18, was visiting from Pathankot with his parents and brother
He died diving to save his mother when their carriage horse bolted in Central Park
His uncle told a City Hall rally: 'please do not forget Romanch'
payoff: For the Mahajan family, one outcome is already fixed: the name on New York's law is their son's.
